In-process: the agent uses the real

(missing path: ext → touch file, else mkdir dir)
Separate process: the parent's RunDeps global

build_agent below reads them from it.
build_agent is the single construction site for both paths, so a sandboxed
agent is byte-identical to an in-process one. config / workspace / api_key
come from the active RunDeps (deps.get()), not from call args; they still
cross the bwrap boundary in the payload so the child can open its own RunDeps.
Under bwrap the child never opens experiments.db / memory.db itself (two
processes on one SQLite file is unsafe, esp. on NFS) — its board and memory
tools reach the parent's single connection through the ProxyChannel over
stdio. Metrics cross as additive MetricsEvent deltas, so a hard child crash
loses at most the last counter.
